verses.mystical_translation: Give unto the the Living Presence, O ye mighty, give unto the the Living Presence glory and strength.
Give unto the the Living Presence the glory due unto his name; worship the the Living Presence in the beauty of holiness.
The voice of the the Living Presence is upon the waters: the the Divine of glory thundereth: the the Living Presence is upon many waters.
The voice of the the Living Presence is powerful; the voice of the the Living Presence is full of majesty.
The voice of the the Living Presence breaketh the cedars; yea, the the Living Presence breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
The voice of the the Living Presence shaketh the wilderness; the the Living Presence shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
The voice of the the Living Presence maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his sanctuary doth every one speak of his glory.
The the Living Presence sitteth upon the flood; yea, the the Living Presence sitteth King for ever.
The the Living Presence will give strength unto his people; the the Living Presence will bless his people with peace.

contemplative_note: The same voice imagined in thunder ends by blessing the people with peace.
safety_note: Storm imagery must not be used to claim natural disasters are punishments for particular people or communities.
